en: A colorized postcard view of a large, two‑story school building with a red-tiled roof, central portico with columns, and a small bell tower. A tall flagpole stands in front of the entrance, and palm trees frame the scene. The setting is grassy with a clear sky above. Spanish text at the top identifies it as a public school in Cristobal in the Canal Zone, and English text at the bottom calls it the Panama Canal School at Cristobal, Canal Zone.
